control.title: Penetration testing
control.description: Commission an independent penetration test at least annually (CERT-In empanelled auditor where required) and track findings to closure.

implementation_notes: Automated in CI/CD and monitored by the SRE on-call rotation.
evidence_hint: Penetration test report and remediation tracker.
acceptance_criteria: A penetration test report from the last 12 months by a qualified tester
Findings are tracked to remediation or accepted with justification

criteria_coverage.criterion: A penetration test report from the last 12 months by a qualified tester
Findings are tracked to remediation or accepted with justification

requirements.title: Code review, VA and PT at least annually and before deployment
requirements.guidance: Source code review, VA and PT at least annually in authenticated mode, vendor certificates for code you don't own, security audit before any deployment, and recurring findings reported to the sub-committee.

requirements.title: Ongoing and separate evaluations
requirements.guidance: Evaluate whether controls are present and functioning, for example internal audits and pen tests.

requirements.title: Internal audits, external audit, half-yearly VAPT and PCI reports
requirements.guidance: Quarterly internal and annual external audit reports to the IT committee, half-yearly VAPT, and PCI DSS AOC or ROC.

requirements.title: Configuration and vulnerability detection
requirements.guidance: Detect configuration changes and new vulnerabilities.

requirements.title: Security testing in development and acceptance
requirements.guidance: Define and run security testing in the development lifecycle.

evidence.title: Penetration testing: how we do it
evidence.description: Automated in CI/CD and monitored by the SRE on-call rotation.
